Court upholds Minnesota ban on AI-generated explicit images

A Minnesota ban on AI-generated explicit nude images will remain in effect after a judge rejected a legal challenge by Elon Musk's xAI. The company had sought to block the law, which is the first of its kind in the nation. Separately, Musk engaged in an online dispute with Chess.com regarding whether artificial intelligence could 'solve' the game of chess.
